title: 24 第24章 快剑25 第25章 两个选择
content_zh:
“前面有个空地，我们去那里。”
神威团的弟子说道。
一行人围着林轩走到了空地处，周围好事的弟子又围了上来，一副看戏的样子。
“怎么回事，昨天不是解决了吗，怎么今天又来了？”
有弟子不解。
“不知道，好像是神威团的成员前来挑战林轩，这是赤裸裸的欺负人啊！”
“靠！
林轩竟然接受了，他脑子没坏掉吧！
对方可是神威团的人啊，他不知道只有精英才能进神威团吗？”
“估计会输的很惨，重伤致残也有可能啊！”
所有人都不看好林轩，因为他们对神威团成员的实力太清楚了，那绝对是同阶中的强者，不然也不会进入神威团。
“每次挑战三十贡献点，敢不敢？”
林轩笑眯眯的说道。
“小子，挑战的规矩你懂吧？”
“废话，除了不准杀人，其他随意，我说的对吗？”
林轩耸了耸肩。
“但愿一会你还能笑的出来！”
神威团的弟子冷笑道。
“废话少说，谁先来！”
林轩眼中闪出兴奋的光芒。

“我来！”
说话的是一个精瘦的弟子，他挎着宝剑走了出来。
迎战的是一名凝脉四阶弟子，他身材瘦高，长相普通，腰间挂着一柄金黄弯刀。
神威团的弟子拿出一个巴掌大的玉质阵盘，催动灵力，那玉质阵盘迎风变大，一杆血红色的大旗出现在空中。
轰的一声，那血色大旗插在地面之上，形成了一个方圆三米的封闭空间，正好将林轩和那名神威团弟子罩在里面。
这就是专门用来切磋的阵旗，它能产生一个独立的小空间，方便弟子切磋，同时防止伤到外人。
和林轩对战的弟子名叫苏兴，修为在凝脉四阶巅峰，只差一步就能迈入凝脉五阶，可以说是在同阶之中少有对手。
他冷笑一声，抽出腰间金色弯刀，一双冰冷的眼睛瞬间盯住了林轩。
“喝！”
苏兴暴喝一声，一跃而起。
手中弯刀化成一道金光，斜皮而出，刀芒闪耀，直指林轩胸口。
林轩一剑点出，速度之快，令人心惊。
锵！
content_en:
"There's an open space ahead, let's go there."
The disciple of the Divine Power Group said.
A group of people walked around Lin Xuan to the open space, and the meddlesome disciples gathered around him again, as if they were watching a show.
"What's going on? Wasn't it solved yesterday? Why is it here again today?"
Some disciples are puzzled.
"I don't know, it seems like a member of the Divine Power Group came to challenge Lin Xuan. This is naked bullying!"
"Fuck!
Lin Xuan actually accepted it, he is not out of his mind!
The other party is from the Kamui Group. Doesn't he know that only elites can join the Kamui Group? "
"I'll probably lose miserably, and it's possible that I'll be seriously injured and disabled!"
Everyone is not optimistic about Lin Xuan, because they are too clear about the strength of the members of the Divine Power Group. They are definitely strong men at the same level, otherwise they would not join the Divine Power Group.
"Do you dare to contribute 30 contribution points to each challenge?"
Lin Xuan said with a smile.
"Boy, do you understand the rules of the challenge?"
"Nonsense, except that no killing is allowed, everything else is optional. Am I right?"
Lin Xuan shrugged.
"I hope you can still laugh after a while!"
The disciple of the Divine Power Group sneered.
"Stop talking nonsense, who comes first!"
Lin Xuan's eyes flashed with excitement.
"I'll do it!"
The speaker was a lean disciple who walked out with a sword in his hand.
The one facing him was a fourth-level disciple of Pulse Condensation. He was tall and thin, with an ordinary appearance, and a golden scimitar hanging from his waist.
The disciples of the Shenwei Regiment took out a palm-sized jade formation disk and activated their spiritual power. The jade formation disk grew larger in the wind, and a blood-red flag appeared in the air.
With a bang, the bloody flag was planted on the ground, forming a three-meter-wide enclosed space, which just happened to cover Lin Xuan and the Shenwei Regiment disciple.
This is the formation flag specially used for sparring. It can create a small independent space to facilitate disciples to sparring while preventing outsiders from being hurt.
The disciple Lin Xuan was fighting was named Su Xing. His cultivation was at the peak of the fourth level of pulse condensation. He was only one step away from reaching the fifth level of pulse condensation. It could be said that he had few opponents at the same level.
He sneered, drew out the golden scimitar from his waist, and stared at Lin Xuan with a pair of cold eyes.
"Drink!"
Su Xing shouted loudly and jumped up.
The scimitar in his hand turned into a ray of golden light and came out at an angle, the blade shining brightly and pointed directly at Lin Xuan's chest.
Lin Xuan struck out with his sword, the speed was frightening.
Clang!
